paragraphs.text: Hesitation breeds dissension. To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back.

Anep is a Khenra warrior and vizier in the service of Hazoret on Amonkhet . Anep first appeared as a named character in the storyline of Amonkhet , where their role as a vizier was introduced, establishing them as a figure of authority within the faith of Hazoret. Later, Anep was made playable in the Foundations Jumpstart product, featured specifically in the Red Zealots deck , reinforcing their association with fiery zeal and combat prowess.

Clad in striking red robes symbolic of their devotion to Hazoret, Anep wielded a spear, the weapon of choice that complemented their warrior spirit. As a Vizier, Anep reinforced the harsh but inspiring doctrine that hesitation was the root of failure, and that only by pressing forward without looking back could one prove worthy of the promised afterlife.
